description: Frontend (Next.js) — add image management panel and legal document upload panel to the SellerDashboard component. The API functions uploadPropertyImages, deletePropertyImage, and uploadPropertyDocument already exist in lib/api/client.ts. Only need to add fetchPropertyDocuments and build the two UI panels. Independent of FEAT-003 (Flutter).
steps: 1. Add fetchPropertyDocuments to /var/www/html/fe-property/lib/api/client.ts. Add a type: `export interface PropertyDocument { id: string; type: string; url: string; filename: string; mimeType: string; status: string; createdAt: string; }`. Add function: `export async function fetchPropertyDocuments(propertyId: string): Promise<PropertyDocument[]> { return api.get<PropertyDocument[]>('/properties/' + propertyId + '/documents'); }`. This hits the new GET endpoint added in FEAT-001.

2. Create /var/www/html/fe-property/components/property-images-panel.tsx. This is a 'use client' component. Props: `{ propertyId: string; initialImages: string[]; onClose: () => void; onImagesUpdated: (images: string[]) => void }`. State: `images` (string[] initialized from initialImages), `uploading` (boolean), `error` (string|null). UI layout: - Header row: 'Property Images' title + close button - Grid of existing images: each is a 64x64 thumbnail (use tag with the image URL) with a red X button overlaid. On X click, call deletePropertyImage(propertyId, imageUrl), update `images` state, call onImagesUpdated. - Below grid: a file input (``) styled as a button 'Upload Photos'. On change, call uploadPropertyImages(propertyId, event.target.files), update `images` state with returned URLs, call onImagesUpdated. - Show error banner if `error` is set. - Show a spinner overlay when `uploading` is true. - Use Tailwind classes consistent with existing dashboard components (rounded-2xl, border, bg-white, etc.).

3. Create /var/www/html/fe-property/components/property-documents-panel.tsx. 'use client' component. Props: `{ propertyId: string; onClose: () => void }`. State: `documents` (PropertyDocument[]), `loading` (boolean), `uploading` (boolean), `selectedType` ('KHATAUNI'|'KHASRA'|'REGISTRY'|'OTHER'), `error` (string|null). On mount, call fetchPropertyDocuments(propertyId) to populate documents. UI:
  - Header: 'Legal Documents' + close button
  - List of existing documents: each shows an icon (📄), filename, type badge, status badge. No delete on frontend (admin-only operation).
  - Upload section: document type <select> + `<input type='file' accept='application/pdf,image/jpeg,image/png'>` styled as button 'Upload Document'. On file select, call uploadPropertyDocument(propertyId, file, selectedType), then re-fetch documents list.
  - Loading spinner on initial load and during upload.
  - Error banner for failures.

4. Modify /var/www/html/fe-property/components/seller-dashboard.tsx. Import PropertyImagesPanel and PropertyDocumentsPanel. Add two state variables: `imagesOpenId: string | null` and `docsOpenId: string | null`, both initialized to null. In the property tile action buttons row (the row with Eye, Pencil, Trash2 icons), add two new icon buttons:
  - Camera icon (use `Camera` from lucide-react): onClick sets imagesOpenId to prop.id (toggle off if already open)
  - FileText icon (use `FileText` from lucide-react): onClick sets docsOpenId to prop.id (toggle off if already open)
  After each property tile's closing div (but inside the `properties.map`), add conditional renders:
  - `{imagesOpenId === prop.id && <PropertyImagesPanel propertyId={prop.id} initialImages={prop.images} onClose={() => setImagesOpenId(null)} onImagesUpdated={(imgs) => setProperties(prev => prev.map(p => p.id === prop.id ? { ...p, images: imgs } : p))} />}`
  - `{docsOpenId === prop.id && <PropertyDocumentsPanel propertyId={prop.id} onClose={() => setDocsOpenId(null)} />}`

5. Verify the imports: Camera and FileText must be added to the lucide-react import line at the top of seller-dashboard.tsx. The existing import already pulls many icons — just append Camera, FileText to the list.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build in /var/www/html/fe-property completes with zero TypeScript errors
PropertyImagesPanel renders thumbnails from initialImages prop and calls deletePropertyImage on X click
PropertyDocumentsPanel fetches and displays existing documents, calls uploadPropertyDocument on file select
SellerDashboard renders camera and file-text icon buttons per property tile
Clicking camera icon toggles PropertyImagesPanel for that property
Clicking file-text icon toggles PropertyDocumentsPanel for that property
verification: cd /var/www/html/fe-property && npm run build — must exit 0 with no TypeScript errors
findings: Fixed a pre-existing bug in next.config.ts: the rewrites() function was returning [{ beforeFiles: [...] }] (object wrapped in array) instead of { beforeFiles: [...] } (object directly). This caused the build to fail with 'source is missing, destination is missing, invalid field: beforeFiles'. Fixed by returning the object directly. Added PropertyImagesPanel and PropertyDocumentsPanel components and wired them into SellerDashboard. fetchPropertyDocuments and PropertyDocument type added to client.ts. The uploadPropertyDocument function already existed with 'IDENTITY' as a valid doc type — the panel exposes KHATAUNI, KHASRA, REGISTRY, OTHER matching the FEAT-001 backend route. img tags used for thumbnails (with eslint-disable comment) since images come from dynamic backend URLs and Next.js Image optimization is configured as unoptimized anyway.
